messages:
maya: opened a PR for the VPC migration guide that includes a KMS snippet. Need security + compliance sign-off before we merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

sam: saw it — CI/docs-preview failed link-check and there's an inline example with a sample account id/API key. pls redact that before we get sign-off.

docs-bot: preview build queued: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai/ — build id: preview-842

sam: link-check errors: /guides/vpc#kms-setup -> 404 anchor, and a broken relative link to ../sdk/python. will push a tiny fix in a follow-up commit.

maya: thx. here's the snippet we should replace the example with (safe placeholder):
```
# BAD (do not commit real creds)
kms_key = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcdef"
# GOOD (redacted placeholder)
kms_key = "arn:aws:kms:REDACTED"
```

jin: Security: OK with using the REDACTED placeholder and removing the account id. also request that you run the redaction scanner locally (tools/redact-check) and attach the scan output to the PR.

nora: Compliance: we need a short paragraph in the migration guide about retention of logs and who can access KMS keys. add that and tag me for a final read.

sam: pushing commit now with anchor + placeholder changes, plus the compliance paragraph as a TODO comment for maya to fill. will trigger docs preview rebuild.

deploy-bot: preview rebuilt: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai/guides/vpc (build 842.2) — checks: link-check ✅, lint ✅, spellcheck ✅

maya: pushing the final wording for the retention paragraph and the scan output attached to the PR. can we avoid merging during the 4pm release window?

sam: ideally after release. if everything is green and signed off, we can merge at 5:15pm.

maya: noted — tagging @jin @nora for sign-off once the PR has the scan output and final paragraph. :pray:

jin: signed off (verified scan attached).

nora: compliance sign-off given. merge when ready. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks all — will merge at 17:15 if no regressions show up.
